summary: The tin-opener recipe matches through wielding and selecting the spinach tin, then the opening message omits C’s possessive: C says “Using your tin opener you try to open the tin.” and JS says “Using tin opener you try to open the tin.” eat.c:start_tin calls objnam.c:yobjnam for this branch; the port calls xnameFresh. Use the existing yobjnam port for the full opener-weapon branch and preserve all opening delays and later spinach effects.

source.branch: eat.c:start_tin (1723-1800), unblessed tin with uwep->otyp == TIN_OPENER: set mesg to “You easily open the tin.”, draw rn2(2) for an uncursed opener, then print “Using %s you try to open the tin.” with yobjnam(uwep, NULL). The selected Valkyrie carries and wields the opener; yobjnam adds “your”.

dependencies: js/objnam.js already ports yobjnam; use it in the opener-weapon message and preserve name handling for daggers, picks, axes, and other eligible weapons.
Keep the existing rn2-based opening duration and consume_tin/occupation flow; all recorded RNG calls already match.
